dispositivos.why: pet-tracker is a GPS unit on a collar, asset-tracker (logistica) tracks shipments, and smartphone-search finds the phone itself. Nothing shows the personal tag for lost things, which SF draws on a dozen objects (wallet, backpack, keys).

dispositivos.name: captions-sparkle
dispositivos.meaning: Captions with a sparkle: captions or subtitles generated by AI, used in video editors, players and meeting recorders
dispositivos.drawing: Captions with a sparkle: captions or subtitles generated by AI, used in video editors, players and meeting recorders
dispositivos.why: captions is the caption track itself. The sparkle says the track was generated, as image-sparkle does for an image. The ia category's exclude rule keeps an AI badge with its object, which puts this one in dispositivos.

dispositivos.name: sim-card-arrow-down
dispositivos.meaning: SIM card with a download arrow: install an eSIM or a cellular plan, used in carrier and travel eSIM apps
dispositivos.drawing: SIM card with a download arrow: install an eSIM or a cellular plan, used in carrier and travel eSIM apps
dispositivos.why: sim-card is the line or plan itself (it is tagged esim). The arrow-down badge is the install step, the family's usual download badge (smartphone-arrow-down, desktop-arrow-down). smartphone-arrow-down installs an app, not a plan.

edicion.name: justify-start
edicion.meaning: Justify start: pack items at the start of the row (flex justify-content)
edicion.drawing: Justify start: pack items at the start of the row (flex justify-content)
edicion.why: align-start lines items up on an edge across the axis. justify packs them along the axis.

edicion.name: justify-center
edicion.meaning: Justify center: pack items in the middle of the row
edicion.drawing: Justify center: pack items in the middle of the row
edicion.why: align-center-horizontal centers items across the axis. This packs them along it.

edicion.name: justify-end
edicion.meaning: Justify end: pack items at the end of the row
edicion.drawing: Justify end: pack items at the end of the row
edicion.why: The same reason as justify-start.

edicion.name: justify-between
edicion.meaning: Space between: the first and last items at the edges, the rest spread between them
edicion.drawing: Space between: the first and last items at the edges, the rest spread between them
edicion.why: distribute-horizontal spaces items evenly. Space-between pins the first and last items to the ends.

edicion.name: padding-top
edicion.why: padding covers the whole box. Padding per side and per axis are the independent-padding controls of design tools, drawn the way border-* draws sides.

edicion.name: padding-right
edicion.why: Per-side padding: padding-top turned.

edicion.name: padding-bottom
edicion.why: Per-side padding: padding-top turned.

edicion.name: padding-left
edicion.why: Per-side padding: padding-top turned.

edicion.name: padding-horizontal
edicion.why: Per-axis padding, the pair auto layout shows first.

edicion.name: padding-vertical
edicion.why: Per-axis padding: padding-horizontal turned.

edicion.name: margin-top
edicion.why: margin covers the whole box. Per-side margins are the box-model controls of web builders.

edicion.name: margin-right
edicion.why: Per-side margin: margin-top turned.

edicion.name: margin-bottom
edicion.why: Per-side margin: margin-top turned.

edicion.name: margin-left
edicion.why: Per-side margin: margin-top turned.

edicion.name: margin-horizontal
edicion.why: Per-axis margin.

edicion.name: margin-vertical
edicion.why: Per-axis margin: margin-horizontal turned.

edicion.name: layers-plus
edicion.why: layers (nucleo) is the panel. Adding a layer is the action design tools use.

edicion.name: list-minus
edicion.why: list-plus exists and its pair doesn't.

edicion.name: star-plus
edicion.why: star toggles a favorite. The explicit add pairs with it the way bookmark-plus pairs with bookmark.

edicion.name: star-minus
edicion.why: The pair of star-plus, as bookmark-minus is for bookmarks.

edicion.name: save-check
edicion.why: save is the action, and editors show the saved state in their status. cloud-check covers the cloud only.

edicion.name: paste-text
edicion.meaning: Paste as plain text: paste without the source's formatting
edicion.drawing: Paste as plain text: paste without the source's formatting
edicion.why: paste keeps the formatting. Pasting as plain text is a separate command in every editor.

edicion.name: text-outline
edicion.meaning: Outline text: turn type into vector shapes
edicion.drawing: Outline text: turn type into vector shapes
edicion.why: stroke-outline turns a stroke into a fill. text-outline turns live type into paths (create outlines).

edicion.name: word-spacing
edicion.meaning: Word spacing: the space between words
edicion.drawing: Word spacing: the space between words
edicion.why: letter-spacing and paragraph-spacing exist. Word spacing is the third kind of spacing in typography.

edicion.name: stroke-variable
edicion.meaning: Variable-width stroke: a line whose thickness changes along its length
edicion.drawing: Variable-width stroke: a line whose thickness changes along its length
edicion.why: line-weight sets one width. A width profile varies the width along the path.

edicion.name: layout-freeform
edicion.meaning: Freeform layout: items placed freely, outside auto layout (absolute position)
edicion.drawing: Freeform layout: items placed freely, outside auto layout (absolute position)
edicion.why: The auto-layout icons exist, but there's none for the free canvas you get when auto layout is off.

edicion.name: table-x
edicion.meaning: The document table with an x badge: delete a whole table from a document, next to Insert table.
edicion.drawing: The document table with an x badge: delete a whole table from a document, next to Insert table.
edicion.why: table-plus inserts a table. row-delete and column-delete (oficina) remove one row or column. Word and Docs have Delete table for the whole table. edicion has 7% badges.

edicion.name: lasso-polygon
edicion.meaning: Polygonal lasso: a selection made of straight dashed segments that close into a polygon, with the lasso's tail. It is the polygonal lasso tool in image editors.
edicion.drawing: Polygonal lasso: a selection made of straight dashed segments that close into a polygon, with the lasso's tail. It is the polygonal lasso tool in image editors.
edicion.why: lasso is the freehand loop, drawn as a dashed ellipse. The polygonal lasso is a separate tool next to it in Photoshop, GIMP and Photopea: you select with straight clicks, and its corners tell it apart. names.mjs flags polygon (formas) as contained, but lasso is the family base and polygon is only the modifier, so the family logic holds.

edicion.name: text-rotate
edicion.meaning: Rotate text: the family's text glyph tilted on a diagonal baseline, with a curved turning arrow. Used for text rotation in a spreadsheet cell or a text box.
edicion.drawing: Rotate text: the family's text glyph tilted on a diagonal baseline, with a curved turning arrow. Used for text rotation in a spreadsheet cell or a text box.
edicion.why: text-vertical stacks upright letters from top to bottom, a writing mode. text-path bends text along a curve. text-rotate tilts the whole line at an angle: Google Sheets' 'Text rotation' button and Excel's 'Orientation'. One name covers Material's seven rotation variants (text-rotation-angleup, angledown, down, none, text-rotate-up, text-up, text-rotate-vertical); its directions come from flipPath and turnPath.

educacion.name: school-desk
educacion.meaning: A student desk with its attached seat, in profile: school desk, seat assignment
educacion.drawing: A student desk with its attached seat, in profile: school desk, seat assignment
educacion.why: desk (oficina) is the office desk. The school desk with its seat attached is another kind, and the scope names it.

educacion.name: pencil-case
educacion.meaning: A zippered pencil case with two pencils peeking out: school supplies
educacion.drawing: A zippered pencil case with two pencils peeking out: school supplies
educacion.why: pencil-cup (oficina) is a desk cup. The scope names the pencil case, the zippered pouch kids carry.

educacion.name: flashcards
educacion.meaning: Two index cards, the front one flipping over: flashcards, memorize, study deck
educacion.drawing: Two index cards, the front one flipping over: flashcards, memorize, study deck
educacion.why: quiz is a question sheet. The study deck of cards flipped to memorize (Anki, Quizlet) isn't drawn.

educacion.name: exam-x
educacion.meaning: Exam with an x badge: exam failed
educacion.drawing: Exam with an x badge: exam failed
educacion.why: exam-check is a passed exam. A failed exam is the other result.

educacion.name: exam-clock
educacion.meaning: Exam with a clock badge: timed exam, exam scheduled
educacion.drawing: Exam with a clock badge: timed exam, exam scheduled
educacion.why: proctoring is a supervised exam. A timed or upcoming exam is a separate state that LMSs show.

educacion.name: homework-x
educacion.meaning: Homework with an x badge: missing or rejected assignment
educacion.drawing: Homework with an x badge: missing or rejected assignment
educacion.why: homework-clock is due and homework-check is turned in. Missing or rejected is the status LMSs flag as 'Missing'.

educacion.name: student-minus
educacion.meaning: Student with a minus badge: unenroll, drop a student from a class
educacion.drawing: Student with a minus badge: unenroll, drop a student from a class
educacion.why: student-plus enrolls a student. Unenrolling is the inverse action.

educacion.name: course-plus
educacion.meaning: Course with a plus badge: create a course, add a course
educacion.drawing: Course with a plus badge: create a course, add a course
educacion.why: course is the course itself. The plus is the create-course action every LMS has.

educacion.name: school-alert
educacion.meaning: School with an alert badge: school closure, school emergency notice
educacion.drawing: School with an alert badge: school closure, school emergency notice
educacion.why: school is the building. The alert carries a closure or emergency notice to families. The public-address search hit is a speaker, not a school.

electrodomesticos.name: juicer
electrodomesticos.meaning: An electric juicer with its feed chute and a glass under the spout: juice extractor, cold-press juicer
electrodomesticos.drawing: An electric juicer with its feed chute and a glass under the spout: juice extractor, cold-press juicer
electrodomesticos.why: The squeezer is a hand reamer, and its 'juicer' keyword is why search finds it. The scope names the juicer among the appliances, and the electric machine isn't drawn.

electrodomesticos.name: waffle-maker
electrodomesticos.meaning: An open waffle iron showing its grid plates: waffle maker, small kitchen appliance
electrodomesticos.drawing: An open waffle iron showing its grid plates: waffle maker, small kitchen appliance
electrodomesticos.why: waffle is the food. The waffle maker is the open hinged iron with its plates, one of the best-selling small kitchen appliances, and searching doesn't find it.

electrodomesticos.name: patio-heater
electrodomesticos.meaning: A tall outdoor patio heater with its reflector hood: heated terrace, outdoor heating
electrodomesticos.drawing: A tall outdoor patio heater with its reflector hood: heated terrace, outdoor heating
electrodomesticos.why: The space heater is an indoor floor unit (its keywords include radiator). The patio heater is the tall pole with a hood that heats terraces. It also says restaurante's 'heated outdoor seating'. One over quota.

electrodomesticos.name: house-arrow-left
electrodomesticos.meaning: A house with an arrow toward it: arrive home, presence detected, home mode, check-in
electrodomesticos.drawing: A house with an arrow toward it: arrive home, presence detected, home mode, check-in
electrodomesticos.why: The 'when I arrive home' trigger in smart-home automations. house-temperature already puts the house family's smart-home states here. The engine's arrow-left badge does it, as in ticket-arrow-right.

electrodomesticos.name: house-arrow-right
electrodomesticos.meaning: A house with an arrow away from it: leave home, away mode, everyone left, check-out
electrodomesticos.drawing: A house with an arrow away from it: leave home, away mode, everyone left, check-out
electrodomesticos.why: The 'when I leave home' trigger: the opposite meaning, so it gets its own name, like barometer-arrow-up and barometer-arrow-down. Engine's arrow-right badge.

electrodomesticos.name: house-humidity
electrodomesticos.meaning: A house with a droplet inside: the indoor humidity reading in smart-home and thermostat apps.
electrodomesticos.drawing: A house with a droplet inside: the indoor humidity reading in smart-home and thermostat apps.
electrodomesticos.why: house-temperature is the indoor temperature, and humidity is the other reading every thermostat shows. hygrometer is the instrument, and humidity-high and humidity-low are the weather.

emociones.name: face-mind-blown
emociones.meaning: Face whose top bursts open in rays: mind blown, astonished, amazed
emociones.drawing: Face whose top bursts open in rays: mind blown, astonished, amazed
emociones.why: Surprised is an open mouth. The scope names mind-blown, and it is not drawn.

emociones.name: face-monocle
emociones.meaning: Face with a monocle on one eye: inspect, scrutinize, curious
emociones.drawing: Face with a monocle on one eye: inspect, scrutinize, curious
emociones.why: Skeptical raises a brow. The monocle means close inspection.

emociones.name: face-sweat
emociones.meaning: Grinning face with a drop of sweat on its brow: phew, awkward relief, nervous laugh
emociones.drawing: Grinning face with a drop of sweat on its brow: phew, awkward relief, nervous laugh
emociones.why: face-nervous is the grimace. The grin with a sweat drop is relief after a close call.

emociones.name: face-injured
emociones.meaning: Face with a bandage wrapped around its head: hurt, injured, accident
emociones.drawing: Face with a bandage wrapped around its head: hurt, injured, accident
emociones.why: face-sick carries the thermometer (illness). The head bandage means injury.

emociones.name: face-melting
emociones.meaning: Smiling face melting into a puddle: overwhelmed, awkward, embarrassed
emociones.drawing: Smiling face melting into a puddle: overwhelmed, awkward, embarrassed
emociones.why: face-hot is heat; its 'melting' tag is literal. The melting face is a different emoji, about overwhelm and embarrassment.

emociones.name: face-exhaling
emociones.meaning: Face blowing out a puff of air: sigh, relief, exhausted
emociones.drawing: Face blowing out a puff of air: sigh, relief, exhausted
emociones.why: Relieved is the calm smile with closed eyes. Exhaling blows out a puff: a sigh.

emociones.name: face-shaking
emociones.meaning: Face with vibration marks on each side: shaken, shocked, rattled
emociones.drawing: Face with vibration marks on each side: shaken, shocked, rattled
emociones.why: Dizzy shows spiral or x eyes. Shaking shows the whole face vibrating.

emociones.name: face-drooling
emociones.meaning: Face with drool running from its mouth: drooling, craving, deep sleep
emociones.drawing: Face with drool running from its mouth: drooling, craving, deep sleep
emociones.why: Yum licks its lips (tasty). Drooling shows drool running from the mouth.

emociones.name: face-saluting
emociones.meaning: Face with a hand at its brow: salute, yes sir, acknowledged, on it
emociones.drawing: Face with a hand at its brow: salute, yes sir, acknowledged, on it
emociones.why: No face says 'acknowledged'. The hand is a custom badge on the face, as the set's tear and thermometer are.

emociones.name: face-sneezing
emociones.meaning: Face with a tissue at its nose: sneeze, cold, allergies
emociones.drawing: Face with a tissue at its nose: sneeze, cold, allergies
emociones.why: face-sick is fever. The tissue at the nose means a cold or allergy.

emociones.name: face-zany
emociones.meaning: Face with one wide eye and one small, tongue out: crazy, wild, goofy
emociones.drawing: Face with one wide eye and one small, tongue out: crazy, wild, goofy
emociones.why: Tongue is playful. Zany adds the mismatched eyes.

emociones.name: face-huffing
emociones.meaning: Face blowing two puffs of steam from its nose: fuming, determined, triumphant
emociones.drawing: Face blowing two puffs of steam from its nose: fuming, determined, triumphant
emociones.why: Angry is the frown. The steam from the nose means fuming or triumph.

emociones.name: heart-fire
emociones.meaning: Heart in flames: passion, burning love, motivation
emociones.drawing: Heart in flames: passion, burning love, motivation
emociones.why: No heart has flames. It builds on edicion's heart and lugares' flame, as the emotion hearts do.

emociones.name: heart-beating
emociones.meaning: Heart with motion arcs on each side: heart beating fast, excitement, crush
emociones.drawing: Heart with motion arcs on each side: heart beating fast, excitement, crush
emociones.why: heart-pulse is the ECG line (health, system status). The beating heart is the emotion.

energia.name: gas-meter
energia.meaning: A household gas meter with its dial and inlet and outlet pipes: gas service, gas reading
energia.drawing: A household gas meter with its dial and inlet and outlet pipes: gas service, gas reading
energia.why: The electricity and water meters are drawn. The scope also names the gas meter, which isn't.

energia.name: gas-meter-edit
energia.meaning: Gas meter with an edit badge: submit a gas reading
energia.drawing: Gas meter with an edit badge: submit a gas reading
energia.why: Completes the submit-a-reading family that electric-meter-edit and water-meter-edit started.

energia.name: outlet-type-c
energia.meaning: Type C outlet (Europlug): two round holes in a round recess
energia.drawing: Type C outlet (Europlug): two round holes in a round recess
energia.why: The family draws types A, B, D, G and I. C is the most widespread type still missing.

energia.name: outlet-type-e
energia.meaning: Type E outlet (France, Belgium): two round holes and a protruding earth pin
energia.drawing: Type E outlet (France, Belgium): two round holes and a protruding earth pin
energia.why: A missing IEC type. The earth pin tells it from C and F.

energia.name: outlet-type-f
energia.meaning: Type F outlet (Schuko): two round holes and side earth clips
energia.drawing: Type F outlet (Schuko): two round holes and side earth clips
energia.why: A missing IEC type, used across most of Europe. The side clips tell it from C and E.

energia.name: outlet-type-h
energia.meaning: Type H outlet (Israel): three holes in a V
energia.drawing: Type H outlet (Israel): three holes in a V
energia.why: A missing IEC type. The V layout tells it from type I's angled slots.

energia.name: outlet-type-j
energia.meaning: Type J outlet (Switzerland): three round holes in a hexagonal recess
energia.drawing: Type J outlet (Switzerland): three round holes in a hexagonal recess
energia.why: A missing IEC type. The hexagonal recess tells it from D and N.

energia.name: outlet-type-k
energia.meaning: Type K outlet (Denmark): two round holes over a half-round earth
energia.drawing: Type K outlet (Denmark): two round holes over a half-round earth
energia.why: A missing IEC type. The half-round earth below the pins makes the distinctive 'smiley' face.

energia.name: outlet-type-l
energia.meaning: Type L outlet (Italy): three round holes in a row
energia.drawing: Type L outlet (Italy): three round holes in a row
energia.why: A missing IEC type. Its three holes in a straight line are unique.

energia.name: outlet-type-n
energia.meaning: Type N outlet (Brazil): three round holes in a rounded recess
energia.drawing: Type N outlet (Brazil): three round holes in a rounded recess
energia.why: A missing IEC type. The rounded recess and offset earth tell it from J. Check the pair at 18 px.

energia.name: manhole
energia.meaning: A manhole cover set in the street: sewage, sewer access, drains
energia.drawing: A manhole cover set in the street: sewage, sewer access, drains
energia.why: storm-drain (medio-ambiente) is a grate for rainwater. The scope names sewage, which has no icon. Draw the cover in perspective so it isn't read as a target.

energia.name: tidal-energy
energia.meaning: An underwater turbine below a wave line: tidal and wave power
energia.drawing: An underwater turbine below a wave line: tidal and wave power
energia.why: hydropower is a dam turbine. Tidal and wave power is the one renewable still missing (solar, wind, hydro, geothermal, biomass and biofuel are drawn).

energia.name: gas-leak
energia.meaning: A gas pipe with fumes escaping from its joint: gas leak, report a leak
energia.drawing: A gas pipe with fumes escaping from its joint: gas leak, report a leak
energia.why: pipeline-leak (industria) is a dripping industrial line. A gas leak at home or in the street, shown by fumes rather than drops, is the emergency gas utilities ask customers to report. The judge may find pipeline-leak enough.

energia.name: utility-pole-clock
energia.meaning: Utility pole with a clock badge: planned power outage, load shedding
energia.drawing: Utility pole with a clock badge: planned power outage, load shedding
energia.why: utility-pole-alert is an outage. A planned outage or load-shedding schedule is the other state utility apps show.

energia.name: solar-farm
energia.meaning: Rows of tilted solar panels on the ground: solar farm, solar park
energia.drawing: Rows of tilted solar panels on the ground: solar farm, solar park
energia.why: wind-farm is drawn but its solar sibling isn't. solar-panel is a single panel. The 'farm' it contains is agricultura's farm.

energia.name: water-tap-alert
energia.meaning: Water tap with an alert badge: water outage, supply interruption
energia.drawing: Water tap with an alert badge: water outage, supply interruption
energia.why: utility-pole-alert covers a power outage. This covers a water outage, on the water-tap base.

energia.name: solar-panel-alert
energia.meaning: The solar panel with an alert badge. Used when a panel or its microinverter is faulty or has stopped reporting in a solar-monitoring app.
energia.drawing: The solar panel with an alert badge. Used when a panel or its microinverter is faulty or has stopped reporting in a solar-monitoring app.
energia.why: solar-panel is the installation itself (tagged panel monitoring). utility-pole-alert is a grid outage, and inverter has no state. Solar-monitoring apps show a faulty or silent panel as its own alert. The 'contains alert' conflict is just the badge family. Energia's badges stay near 10%.

energia.name: boiler-alert
energia.meaning: The boiler with an alert badge. Used for a boiler fault or error code in smart-heating and boiler-maker apps.
energia.drawing: The boiler with an alert badge. Used for a boiler fault or error code in smart-heating and boiler-maker apps.
energia.why: boiler is the appliance; its keywords cover service visits, not a fault. machine-alert is a factory machine and engine-alert is a car. Heating apps notify a boiler fault with its error code as a state of a device people manage. The boiler body leaves its corner free for the badge. The 'contains alert' conflict is just the badge family.

entretenimiento.name: zoo
entretenimiento.meaning: A giraffe looking over a zoo fence; zoos, wildlife parks.
entretenimiento.drawing: A giraffe looking over a zoo fence; zoos, wildlife parks.
entretenimiento.why: The animals carry 'zoo' as a tag, but the venue, which the scope lists, has no icon. The fence turns the animal into a place.

entretenimiento.drawing: A figure balancing on a wire with a long pole; circus acts, balance.

entretenimiento.name: trapeze

entretenimiento.drawing: An acrobat swinging from a trapeze bar on two ropes; circus aerial acts.
entretenimiento.why: swing-set is a playground. With an acrobat hanging from the bar it reads as a circus act.

entretenimiento.name: cinema-seat-x
entretenimiento.meaning: A theater seat with an x badge: a seat that is taken or unavailable, in a seat map's legend (cinemas, theaters, stadium seating).
entretenimiento.drawing: A theater seat with an x badge: a seat that is taken or unavailable, in a seat map's legend (cinemas, theaters, stadium seating).
entretenimiento.why: cinema-seat-check is the seat you selected and cinema-seat is an available seat. Every seat-map legend also needs the third state, sold or blocked, which the x badge shows. Seats are bookings. Entretenimiento's badges go from 4 to 5 of about 46 (11 %).

espacio.name: eclipse-lunar
espacio.meaning: Lunar eclipse: the full moon passing into the curved edge of the Earth's shadow
espacio.drawing: Lunar eclipse: the full moon passing into the curved edge of the Earth's shadow
espacio.why: eclipse is the solar eclipse: the sun covered, with corona rays. The lunar eclipse is the moon in Earth's shadow, with no rays. Lucide's eclipse (two overlapping discs) has no equivalent. The shadow's convex edge tells it from a moon phase. The name joins the eclipse family.

espacio.name: space-probe
espacio.meaning: A deep-space probe: a small body with a large dish antenna and a long boom
espacio.drawing: A deep-space probe: a small body with a large dish antenna and a long boom
espacio.why: satellite is an Earth-orbit body with solar wings. A deep-space probe is told by its big dish and boom (Voyager-style missions).

espacio.name: space-telescope
espacio.meaning: A space telescope: an open tube with its aperture door and two solar wings
espacio.drawing: A space telescope: an open tube with its aperture door and two solar wings
espacio.why: telescope is the ground scope on its tripod and radio-telescope is a dish. An orbiting telescope is another kind, told by its tube and wings.

espacio.name: rocket-clock
espacio.meaning: Rocket with a clock badge: scheduled launch, launch countdown
espacio.drawing: Rocket with a clock badge: scheduled launch, launch countdown

espacio.name: rocket-x

espacio.drawing: Rocket with an x badge: launch aborted, scrubbed launch
espacio.why: The aborted or scrubbed launch: the failure that pairs with rocket-check.

fiestas.drawing: A horn of plenty spilling fruit; harvest festivals, Thanksgiving, abundance.

fiestas.name: trick-or-treat
fiestas.meaning: A jack-o'-lantern pail with a handle and candy; trick-or-treat, Halloween candy.
fiestas.drawing: A jack-o'-lantern pail with a handle and candy; trick-or-treat, Halloween candy.

fiestas.name: heart-box
fiestas.meaning: A heart-shaped box of chocolates with a bow; Valentine's gifts.
fiestas.drawing: A heart-shaped box of chocolates with a bow; Valentine's gifts.

fitness.name: kettlebell
fitness.meaning: The kettlebell alone, bell and handle: kettlebell training, gym equipment
fitness.drawing: The kettlebell alone, bell and handle: kettlebell training, gym equipment

fitness.drawing: Whole figure in a boxing stance, gloves up: boxing workout, cardio boxing

fitness.name: rock-climbing
fitness.meaning: Whole figure on a steep wall reaching for a hold: climbing, bouldering gym
fitness.drawing: Whole figure on a steep wall reaching for a hold: climbing, bouldering gym

fitness.name: nordic-walking
fitness.meaning: Whole figure walking with two poles: Nordic walking workout
fitness.drawing: Whole figure walking with two poles: Nordic walking workout
fitness.why: walking (lugares) is a travel mode. The poles make it a workout. The figure builds on walking.

fitness.name: step-aerobics
fitness.meaning: Whole figure stepping onto a low platform, arms up: step class, aerobics
fitness.drawing: Whole figure stepping onto a low platform, arms up: step class, aerobics
fitness.why: box-jump is a plyometric jump. Aerobics is not drawn at all.

fitness.name: online-workout

fitness.drawing: Laptop with a figure exercising on its screen: online class, home workout, virtual training

fitness.name: overhead-press

fitness.drawing: Standing figure pressing a barbell overhead: shoulder press

fitness.name: bicep-curl

fitness.drawing: Standing figure curling a dumbbell: arm workout, biceps curl

fitness.name: bent-over-row
fitness.meaning: Figure hinged forward pulling a barbell to its waist: back workout, row
fitness.drawing: Figure hinged forward pulling a barbell to its waist: back workout, row

fitness.name: triceps-dip

fitness.drawing: Figure lowered between two parallel bars: dips

fitness.name: rope-climb
fitness.meaning: Figure climbing a hanging rope: rope climb
fitness.drawing: Figure climbing a hanging rope: rope climb
fitness.why: It is a different apparatus and exercise.

fitness.name: farmers-carry

fitness.drawing: Figure walking with a weight in each hand: loaded carry

fitness.name: wall-sit
fitness.meaning: Figure seated against a wall, thighs level, no chair: wall sit, isometric hold
fitness.drawing: Figure seated against a wall, thighs level, no chair: wall sit, isometric hold
fitness.why: The squat moves. The wall sit is an isometric hold against a wall.

fitness.name: handstand
fitness.meaning: Figure upside down on its hands: handstand, calisthenics
fitness.drawing: Figure upside down on its hands: handstand, calisthenics
fitness.why: No inverted figure exists. It is used for calisthenics and gymnastics training.

fitness.name: body-fat
fitness.meaning: A body outline with a percent badge: body fat percentage from a smart scale or body-composition reading (Withings, Fitbit Aria, InBody, MyFitnessPal).
fitness.drawing: A body outline with a percent badge: body fat percentage from a smart scale or body-composition reading (Withings, Fitbit Aria, InBody, MyFitnessPal).
fitness.why: body-height is the body measured for height, and waist-measure is a tape around a waist. Nothing in the set shows body composition, the number smart scales report next to weight. The percent badge already exists on droplet-percent and price-tag-percent, and the body is the family's base, so the drawing reuses both. Fitness's scope includes body measurements. It could also sit beside body-height in anatomia.

formas.name: circle
formas.meaning: Circle: the round primitive as a shape
formas.drawing: Circle: the round primitive as a shape
formas.why: formas has every primitive but the circle, since ellipse is the oval. The same outline means an empty radio button in sistema.

formas.name: square
formas.meaning: Square: four equal sides as a shape
formas.drawing: Square: four equal sides as a shape
formas.why: rectangle is the 2:1 primitive. checkbox (sistema) draws a square as an unchecked box, not as a shape.

formas.name: squircle
formas.meaning: Squircle: the superellipse between a square and a circle (the shape of app icons)
formas.drawing: Squircle: the superellipse between a square and a circle (the shape of app icons)
formas.why: corner-radius is the editing control. The squircle is the shape itself.

formas.name: acute-angle
formas.meaning: Acute angle: an angle under ninety degrees
formas.drawing: Acute angle: an angle under ninety degrees
formas.why: angle, right-angle, and obtuse-angle exist. acute completes the set geometry lessons use.

formas.name: symmetry-radial
formas.meaning: Radial symmetry: a shape repeated around a center
formas.drawing: Radial symmetry: a shape repeated around a center
formas.why: symmetry-quadrant mirrors a shape across two axes. Radial symmetry repeats it by rotation, as mandalas and kaleidoscope tools do.

formas.name: dodecahedron
formas.meaning: Dodecahedron: the solid of twelve pentagons
formas.drawing: Dodecahedron: the solid of twelve pentagons
formas.why: Four Platonic solids are drawn: tetrahedron, cube, octahedron, and icosahedron. This is the fifth.

formas.name: line-end-dot
formas.meaning: Dot line end: a line ending in a round marker (connectors, timelines)
formas.drawing: Dot line end: a line ending in a round marker (connectors, timelines)
formas.why: stroke-cap-round rounds the end of the stroke itself. This marker is a larger dot at the end, one of the line-end options in design and diagram tools.

formas.name: line-end-diamond
formas.meaning: Diamond line end: a line ending in a diamond marker
formas.drawing: Diamond line end: a line ending in a diamond marker
formas.why: The caps shape the end of the stroke. The diamond marker is a separate line-end option, and it is also UML's aggregation mark.

foto-video.name: image-minus
foto-video.meaning: A photo with a minus; take a photo out of an album or selection without deleting it.
foto-video.drawing: A photo with a minus; take a photo out of an album or selection without deleting it.
foto-video.why: image-x is delete or reject. A minus removes from a set, the same distinction as file-minus and file-x.

foto-video.name: image-play
foto-video.meaning: A photo with a play badge; animated images, GIFs, motion photos.
foto-video.drawing: A photo with a play badge; animated images, GIFs, motion photos.
foto-video.why: image-to-video (ia) is AI animation. This one plays an image that is already animated. Heroicons' gif maps here too, since the letters are never drawn.

foto-video.name: metering-center-weighted
foto-video.meaning: A frame with a large circle in the middle; center-weighted metering mode.
foto-video.drawing: A frame with a large circle in the middle; center-weighted metering mode.
foto-video.why: Spot is a dot and matrix is a grid. Center-weighted is the third standard metering mode, and the scope lists metering.

foto-video.name: clip-speed
foto-video.meaning: A clip with a speedometer; change a clip's playback speed, speed ramps.
foto-video.drawing: A clip with a speedometer; change a clip's playback speed, speed ramps.
foto-video.why: The clip family has split, trim and transition. Speed is a standard action in video editors.

foto-video.name: clip-reverse
foto-video.meaning: A clip with a backward arrow; play a clip in reverse.
foto-video.drawing: A clip with a backward arrow; play a clip in reverse.
foto-video.why: Reverse playback is its own editor action, and the clip family doesn't have it.

foto-video.name: clip-freeze
foto-video.meaning: A clip with one frame held; freeze frame in a video editor.
foto-video.drawing: A clip with one frame held; freeze frame in a video editor.
foto-video.why: Freeze frame is its own editor action. row-freeze in oficina is the spreadsheet freeze, a different thing.

foto-video.name: teleprompter
foto-video.meaning: A camera lens behind an angled glass showing text lines; teleprompters, reading a script on camera.
foto-video.drawing: A camera lens behind an angled glass showing text lines; teleprompters, reading a script on camera.
foto-video.why: screenplay is the script. The teleprompter is the glass in front of the lens, a filmmaking tool with no icon.

foto-video.name: microphone-lavalier
foto-video.meaning: A small clip-on lavalier mic on its cable; interviews, video creators.
foto-video.drawing: A small clip-on lavalier mic on its cable; interviews, video creators.
foto-video.why: The boom mic hangs overhead on a pole. The lav is the clip-on mic every interview setup uses, and it joins the microphone-* family.

foto-video.name: image-alert
foto-video.meaning: A photo with an alert badge: the photo needs attention because it is too low-resolution to print, blurry, or flagged (photo-book and print services, listing editors).
foto-video.drawing: A photo with an alert badge: the photo needs attention because it is too low-resolution to print, blurry, or flagged (photo-book and print services, listing editors).
foto-video.why: image-off means unavailable or failed to load, with no picture. image-alert is a photo that loaded but carries a warning, like the low-resolution triangle print services show on a photo-book page. It completes the image-* badge family (edit, heart, check, lock, x, minus) and follows the family's logic. names.mjs's 'contains' hits are only the family's base and the badge word. Foto-video's badges go from 12 to 13 of about 92.

frutas-verduras.name: dragon-fruit
frutas-verduras.meaning: A dragon fruit with its pointed, flame-like scales: pitaya, pitahaya, tropical fruit, smoothie bowls
frutas-verduras.drawing: A dragon fruit with its pointed, flame-like scales: pitaya, pitahaya, tropical fruit, smoothie bowls
frutas-verduras.why: Passion fruit is a plain round. The dragon fruit is told by its scales. No icon has it under any name (searching 'pitaya' finds nothing).

frutas-verduras.name: pistachio
frutas-verduras.meaning: A pistachio with its shell split open and the nut showing: nuts, snacks, pistachio flavor
frutas-verduras.drawing: A pistachio with its shell split open and the nut showing: nuts, snacks, pistachio flavor
frutas-verduras.why: The peanut is a waisted pod and the almond a smooth teardrop. The pistachio is the half-open shell with the nut inside. It's a top nut and a common flavor, and searching for it finds nothing.

frutas-verduras.name: tomatillo
frutas-verduras.meaning: A tomatillo with its papery husk peeled back: tomate verde, green salsa, physalis
frutas-verduras.drawing: A tomatillo with its papery husk peeled back: tomate verde, green salsa, physalis
frutas-verduras.why: The tomato is the bare fruit with its calyx. The tomatillo is told by its papery husk. A staple of Mexican cooking that searching doesn't find.

frutas-verduras.name: lupin
frutas-verduras.meaning: A lupin flower spike above its palm-shaped leaf: the lupin allergen, lupin flour, lupini beans
frutas-verduras.drawing: A lupin flower spike above its palm-shaped leaf: the lupin allergen, lupin flour, lupini beans
frutas-verduras.why: Lupin is one of the 14 allergens in restaurante's scope, and the only one that is a food with no drawing. The rest are keywords on peanut, celery, wheat, mussel, shrimp, and so on. Sulphites have nothing to draw; see notes. The palm-shaped leaf keeps it apart from lavender.

frutas-verduras.name: kohlrabi
frutas-verduras.meaning: A kohlrabi bulb with its leaf stems rising from its sides: European and Asian vegetables, veg boxes
frutas-verduras.drawing: A kohlrabi bulb with its leaf stems rising from its sides: European and Asian vegetables, veg boxes
frutas-verduras.why: The turnip's leaves rise only from the top of a round root. Kohlrabi's stems rise from the sides of the bulb. Less common in the Americas, standard in European and Asian produce.

frutas-verduras.name: fennel
frutas-verduras.meaning: A fennel bulb with its short stalks and feathery fronds: Mediterranean vegetables, anise flavor
frutas-verduras.drawing: A fennel bulb with its short stalks and feathery fronds: Mediterranean vegetables, anise flavor
frutas-verduras.why: Celery is a bunch of stalks and the spring onion a long white bulb. Fennel is a squat white bulb with feathery fronds. Risk: the fronds have to carry it.

gestos.name: hand-helping
gestos.meaning: Open hand held out palm up, nothing on it: lend a hand, offer help, assistance
gestos.drawing: Open hand held out palm up, nothing on it: lend a hand, offer help, assistance
gestos.why: hand-receive adds an arrow into the palm, and donation adds a heart. The helping hand is the bare offered palm (comercio's donation palm).

gestos.name: hand-horns
gestos.meaning: Index and little finger up, thumb folded over the others: rock on, metal
gestos.drawing: Index and little finger up, thumb folded over the others: rock on, metal
gestos.why: love-you has the thumb out. The horns fold the thumb in. Lucide draws its hand-metal with the thumb out, which is why it stayed unmapped.

gestos.name: hand-fingers-crossed
gestos.meaning: Index and middle finger crossed: good luck, fingers crossed, hope
gestos.drawing: Index and middle finger crossed: good luck, fingers crossed, hope
gestos.why: Peace spreads two fingers in a V. Here one finger wraps over the other.

gestos.name: hand-call-me
gestos.meaning: Thumb and little finger out: call me, shaka, hang loose
gestos.drawing: Thumb and little finger out: call me, shaka, hang loose
gestos.why: love-you also raises the index. Call-me shows only the thumb and the little finger.

gestos.name: hand-finger-heart
gestos.meaning: Thumb and index crossed into a small heart: finger heart, love, thanks
gestos.drawing: Thumb and index crossed into a small heart: finger heart, love, thanks
gestos.why: OK closes a ring, and the finger heart crosses the tips. The heart at the tips is small, so check it at 18 px. The 'heart' contains is the gesture's own name.

gestos.name: hand-fist-bump
gestos.meaning: The fist from the front with impact lines: fist bump, respect, deal
gestos.drawing: The fist from the front with impact lines: fist bump, respect, deal
gestos.why: hand-fist means strength. The scope names the fist bump, and two fists fail at 24 px (round 7), so one fist with impact lines says it.

gestos.name: hand-count-three
gestos.meaning: Three fingers up, the thumb holding the little finger: count three, quantity
gestos.drawing: Three fingers up, the thumb holding the little finger: count three, quantity
gestos.why: The scope lists counting one to five. One and two exist (hand-point-up, hand-peace); three does not.

gestos.name: hand-count-four
gestos.meaning: Four fingers up, the thumb folded: count four, quantity
gestos.drawing: Four fingers up, the thumb folded: count four, quantity
gestos.why: hand-raised shows the whole hand with the thumb. Four folds the thumb.

gestos.name: hand-count-five
gestos.meaning: Open hand with the five fingers spread: count five, high five
gestos.drawing: Open hand with the five fingers spread: count five, high five
gestos.why: hand-raised keeps the fingers together (raise hand). The five spread fingers count five. It is named count-five because hand-spread is the touch gesture.

gestos.name: hand-triple-tap
gestos.meaning: The touch hand with three ripples: triple tap, magnifier and accessibility shortcut
gestos.drawing: The touch hand with three ripples: triple tap, magnifier and accessibility shortcut
gestos.why: Triple tap is a different system gesture. It belongs to the hand-tap family, as double tap does.

gestos.name: hand-three-finger-tap
gestos.meaning: Three fingers touching with ripples: three-finger tap, look up, undo menu
gestos.drawing: Three fingers touching with ripples: three-finger tap, look up, undo menu
gestos.why: It is a different gesture. The family already has two-finger tap and three-finger swipe.

gestos.name: hand-four-finger-swipe
gestos.meaning: Four fingers with a swipe arrow: four-finger swipe, switch desktops or apps
gestos.drawing: Four fingers with a swipe arrow: four-finger swipe, switch desktops or apps
gestos.why: Trackpads and tablets use four fingers to switch spaces and apps.

gestos.name: hand-air-pinch
gestos.meaning: Thumb and index pinched in the air with a ripple, no screen: air tap, select in AR and VR
gestos.drawing: Thumb and index pinched in the air with a ripple, no screen: air tap, select in AR and VR
gestos.why: hand-pinch is the touch zoom, with fingers closing on a screen. hand-hover is touchless hover. The air pinch is the spatial select.

hardware.name: display-port
hardware.meaning: The DisplayPort socket, a rectangle with one corner cut, used for video output to a monitor.
hardware.drawing: The DisplayPort socket, a rectangle with one corner cut, used for video output to a monitor.
hardware.why: hdmi-port carries 'displayport' only as a keyword. The ports family draws each connector by its shape, and DisplayPort has one cut corner where HDMI has two. SF's video cable connector points here.

hardware.name: usb-b-port
hardware.meaning: The squarish USB-B socket with beveled top corners, found on printers, audio interfaces, and microcontroller boards (Arduino Uno).
hardware.drawing: The squarish USB-B socket with beveled top corners, found on printers, audio interfaces, and microcontroller boards (Arduino Uno).
hardware.why: The USB family has usb-a-port, usb-c-port, and micro-usb-port, and B is the remaining common shape.

hardware.name: rocker-switch
hardware.meaning: A rocker switch tilted on its pivot: the on/off switch of power supplies, power strips, and appliances.
hardware.drawing: A rocker switch tilted on its pivot: the on/off switch of power supplies, power strips, and appliances.
hardware.why: toggle-switch is a bat lever, slide-switch slides, and push-button presses. The rocker's pivoting paddle is the switch most people know from a PSU or power strip.

herramientas.name: vise
herramientas.meaning: A bench vise with its jaws, screw handle and base: holding work, workshop
herramientas.drawing: A bench vise with its jaws, screw handle and base: holding work, workshop
herramientas.why: clamp and bar-clamp are portable clamps. The scope names vises, the kind bolted to a bench.

herramientas.name: sander
herramientas.meaning: A palm orbital sander with its round pad and dust bag: sanding, finishing wood
herramientas.drawing: A palm orbital sander with its round pad and dust bag: sanding, finishing wood
herramientas.why: sandpaper is the sheet. The scope names the power sander. Its round pad and dust bag tell it from a clothes iron.

herramientas.name: laser-measure
herramientas.meaning: A handheld laser distance meter with its dashed beam: measure distance
herramientas.drawing: A handheld laser distance meter with its dashed beam: measure distance
herramientas.why: laser-pointer (oficina) is a presenter and measure-distance (lugares) is a map tool. The scope names the handheld laser meter.

herramientas.name: tool-belt
herramientas.meaning: A tool belt with its pouches and a hammer hanging: tradespeople, handyman
herramientas.drawing: A tool belt with its pouches and a hammer hanging: tradespeople, handyman
herramientas.why: tool-bag is a carried bag and belt (ropa) is clothing. The scope names tool belts. Its words contain 'tools' and 'belt', but it is neither one.

herramientas.name: socket-wrench
herramientas.meaning: A ratchet handle with a socket on its head: socket wrench, ratchet
herramientas.drawing: A ratchet handle with a socket on its head: socket wrench, ratchet
herramientas.why: The drawn spanners (open, ring, adjustable, pipe, torque, lug) lack the ratchet and socket, the most common kind. It follows pipe-wrench and torque-wrench.

herramientas.name: wing-nut
herramientas.meaning: A wing nut with its two flat wings: fasteners, hand-tightened
herramientas.drawing: A wing nut with its two flat wings: fasteners, hand-tightened
herramientas.why: hex-nut needs a wrench. The wing nut is the hand-tightened kind, and no fastener icon draws it.

herramientas.name: cable-tie
herramientas.meaning: A zip tie looped through its head: cable ties, cable management
herramientas.drawing: A zip tie looped through its head: cable ties, cable management
herramientas.why: bungee-cord is elastic with hooks. The zip tie, a plastic strip with a ratchet head, isn't drawn.

herramientas.name: blowtorch
herramientas.meaning: A propane blowtorch, the canister with its nozzle and flame: soldering pipes, brazing
herramientas.drawing: A propane blowtorch, the canister with its nozzle and flame: soldering pipes, brazing
herramientas.why: heat-gun blows hot air and soldering-iron is the pen. The propane torch with its open flame (plumbing, brazing) isn't drawn.

hogar.name: door-lock
hogar.meaning: A closed door with a lock: locked door, restricted room, door locked status
hogar.drawing: A closed door with a lock: locked door, restricted room, door locked status
hogar.why: smart-lock is the device and pet-door-lock the pet flap. This is the door hogar adopts, with the engine's lock: a room or door that is locked. The car-lock hit is the car.

hogar.name: door-gear
hogar.meaning: A closed door with a gear: door settings, door automation, access configuration
hogar.drawing: A closed door with a gear: door settings, door automation, access configuration
hogar.why: The door with the engine's gear glyph, as house-gear and window-gear are. A thin concept, and the judge may drop it, but it costs one badge.

hogar.name: garage-alert
hogar.meaning: A garage with an alert: garage door left open, obstruction, garage door fault
hogar.drawing: A garage with an alert: garage door left open, obstruction, garage door fault
hogar.why: garage-open is the state. The alert is the smart-home warning that SF Symbols draws for every garage door, like fridge-alert and smart-lock-alert. Hogar has 3 badges out of 126.

hogar.name: windowpane-alert
hogar.meaning: A house window with an alert badge: a window left open, the open-window detection in security and heating apps.
hogar.drawing: A house window with an alert badge: a window left open, the open-window detection in security and heating apps.
hogar.why: door-sensor-open is the contact sensor. An alert on the window itself is how security and thermostat apps flag an open window. windowpane has no state yet, and hogar's badge share is 5%.

ia.name: agent-minus
ia.meaning: The AI agent with a minus badge, used to remove or deactivate an agent or bot.
ia.drawing: The AI agent with a minus badge, used to remove or deactivate an agent or bot.
ia.why: agent-plus adds and agent-alert is a failed run. Nothing removes one. Lucide's bot-check and bot-plus already have agent-check and agent-plus, and bot-x has agent-alert, so this is the only bot-* action Gota lacks.

ia.name: brain-gear
ia.meaning: The brain with a gear badge: AI settings, the preferences page for an app's AI features.
ia.drawing: The brain with a gear badge: AI settings, the preferences page for an app's AI features.
ia.why: prompt-gear is the system prompt (custom instructions), and agent-gear configures one agent. brain-circuit and brain-clock are the AI head of the family, but none of them is the AI-features settings section.

ia.name: text-to-3d
ia.meaning: Typed text flowing along the text-to arrow into a cube: generating a 3D model or asset from a prompt, as text-to-3D tools do.
ia.drawing: Typed text flowing along the text-to arrow into a cube: generating a 3D model or asset from a prompt, as text-to-3D tools do.
ia.why: text-to-image ends in a picture. file-3d and cube are a 3D model, not the act of generating one. Every member of the text-to family (image, video, speech, music, sql) puts its output at the end of the same text and arrow, and a cube is the one generated output it doesn't have yet (Meshy, Tripo, Luma Genie, Spline AI). Search finds nothing for it in ia.

industria.name: welding-torch
industria.meaning: An oxy-fuel welding torch with its angled tip and flame: welding, cutting metal
industria.drawing: An oxy-fuel welding torch with its angled tip and flame: welding, cutting metal
industria.why: welding-mask (seguridad-laboral) is the protective helmet. Nothing draws welding itself, and the scope names it. The torch has a straight body, not a pistol grip, and shows the process by its flame rather than a weld seam (which read as a zipper).

industria.name: flow-meter
industria.meaning: A pipe with an inline meter and a flow arrow: flow rate, process measurement
industria.drawing: A pipe with an inline meter and a flow arrow: flow rate, process measurement
industria.why: pressure-gauge measures pressure and water-meter is the household meter. The inline flow meter is the measurement on the pipes, pumps and valves the scope covers.

industria.name: machine-wrench
industria.meaning: Machine with a wrench badge: machine under maintenance
industria.drawing: Machine with a wrench badge: machine under maintenance
industria.why: machine-check (running), machine-alert (fault) and machine-clock (idle) are drawn. 'Under maintenance' is the state MES and CMMS boards still lack. Wrench is already a badge in lightbulb-wrench.

juegos.name: playing-card-deck
juegos.meaning: A deck of playing cards squared in a stack; card games, draw pile, flashcards.
juegos.drawing: A deck of playing cards squared in a stack; card games, draw pile, flashcards.
juegos.why: The fan is a hand held open, and playing-card is one card. Lucide's playing-cards (a squared deck) had no equivalent. This is the weakest of the list: both cards already carry the tag 'deck'.

juegos.name: block-tower
juegos.meaning: A tall tower of stacked wooden blocks with one pulled half out; tumbling-tower stacking games.
juegos.drawing: A tall tower of stacked wooden blocks with one pulled half out; tumbling-tower stacking games.
juegos.why: building-blocks are toddler cubes. The tall tower with one block pulled out is the party stacking game.

juegos.name: hula-hoop
juegos.meaning: A figure spinning a hoop at the waist; hula hoops, kids' play.
juegos.drawing: A figure spinning a hoop at the waist; hula hoops, kids' play.
juegos.why: ring-toss throws rings at pegs. The hoop is drawn on a figure because the ring alone would read as a ring.

juegos.name: toy-wagon
juegos.meaning: A kids' pull wagon on four wheels with its long handle; toy wagons.
juegos.drawing: A kids' pull wagon on four wheels with its long handle; toy wagons.
juegos.why: toy-car is a car, and car-wagon (vehiculos) is a station wagon. The pull wagon is a separate classic toy.

juegos.name: dice-cup
juegos.meaning: A dice cup tipping out two dice; dice games, rolling dice.
juegos.drawing: A dice cup tipping out two dice; dice games, rolling dice.
juegos.why: dice-pair is the dice alone. The cup pouring them says a roll in dice games, and no icon has it.

lectura.name: book-x
lectura.meaning: A book with an x; did not finish, unavailable or banned book.
lectura.drawing: A book with an x; did not finish, unavailable or banned book.
lectura.why: The opposite of book-check. Reading apps track 'did not finish', and file-x and mail-x set the precedent.

lectura.name: book-minus
lectura.meaning: A book with a minus; remove a book from a list or shelf.
lectura.drawing: A book with a minus; remove a book from a list or shelf.
lectura.why: The opposite of book-plus. Removing is a real action, separate from book-x, as file-minus is separate from file-x.

lectura.name: book-upload
lectura.meaning: A book with an up arrow; publish or upload a book or manuscript.
lectura.drawing: A book with an up arrow; publish or upload a book or manuscript.
lectura.why: The opposite of book-download, the action of a publisher or self-publisher. book-cover is the cover art. Lucide's book-up-2 maps here too.

lectura.name: book-alert
lectura.meaning: A book with an alert badge; content warning, errata, overdue notice.
lectura.drawing: A book with an alert badge; content warning, errata, overdue notice.
lectura.why: book-clock is the loan due date. An alert covers warnings and errata, as file-alert does.

lectura.name: book-horror
lectura.meaning: A book with a skull on the cover; the horror genre.
lectura.drawing: A book with a skull on the cover; the horror genre.
lectura.why: Genre family: fantasy, sci-fi and mystery exist, and horror is the next big shelf. Draw it the way book-fantasy is drawn.

lectura.name: book-romance
lectura.meaning: A book with a rose on the cover; the romance genre.
lectura.drawing: A book with a rose on the cover; the romance genre.
lectura.why: book-heart means favorite books, so romance takes a rose instead of a heart.

lectura.name: book-history
lectura.meaning: A book with a classical column on the cover; history books.
lectura.drawing: A book with a classical column on the cover; history books.
lectura.why: antique-book is an old object. History is a genre shelf.

lectura.name: book-biography
lectura.meaning: A book with a portrait bust on the cover; biographies and memoirs.
lectura.drawing: A book with a portrait bust on the cover; biographies and memoirs.
lectura.why: author is the writer figure. Biography is a genre shelf.

lectura.name: book-poetry
lectura.meaning: A book with a quill on the cover; poetry collections.
lectura.drawing: A book with a quill on the cover; poetry collections.
lectura.why: book-quote is a quoted passage. The scope lists poetry, and it has no icon.

lectura.name: newspaper-local
lectura.meaning: A newspaper with a map pin; the local news section.
lectura.drawing: A newspaper with a map pin; the local news section.
lectura.why: Gota has the world, business, opinion and sports sections. Local is the other section every news app has.

lectura.name: newspaper-bolt
lectura.meaning: A newspaper with a lightning bolt; breaking news, live updates.
lectura.drawing: A newspaper with a lightning bolt; breaking news, live updates.
lectura.why: newspaper-digital is the online edition. Breaking news is its own common alert, and nothing in the set covers it.

lectura.name: book-light
lectura.meaning: A clip-on reading light shining onto an open book; reading at night, reading lamps.
lectura.drawing: A clip-on reading light shining onto an open book; reading at night, reading lamps.
lectura.why: The scope names reading lamps. desk-lamp (oficina) is a generic lamp, and the book light belongs to reading.

legal.name: cookie-x
legal.meaning: Cookies rejected: the cookie with an x badge, 'reject all'
legal.drawing: Cookies rejected: the cookie with an x badge, 'reject all'
legal.why: accept exists; 'reject all' is the other button every cookie banner must show

legal.name: consent-x
legal.meaning: Consent withdrawn: the consent hand holding an x instead of the check
legal.drawing: Consent withdrawn: the consent hand holding an x instead of the check
legal.why: consent is consent given; withdrawing it is a right under GDPR and Mexico's LFPDPPP and needs its own state

legal.name: personal-data-block
legal.meaning: Do not sell or share my personal information: personal data with the block badge
legal.drawing: Do not sell or share my personal information: personal data with the block badge
legal.why: personal-data-x is erasure. The CCPA opt-out of sale or sharing is a separate link sites must show.

legal.name: license-check
legal.meaning: Permit approved: the license with a check badge
legal.drawing: Permit approved: the license with a check badge
legal.why: permit pending exists, approved doesn't. driver-license-check is a verified driver, another family.

legal.name: patent-clock
legal.meaning: Patent pending: the patent with a clock badge
legal.drawing: Patent pending: the patent with a clock badge
legal.why: 'patent pending', the status between filing and grant, is the most common thing products say about a patent

legal.name: contract-search
legal.meaning: Contract review: the contract with the magnifier badge, searching clauses
legal.drawing: Contract review: the contract with the magnifier badge, searching clauses
legal.why: law-book-search is legal research in the law; this reviews a contract, a core legal-tech action

legal.name: protest-sign
legal.meaning: Protest: a blank picket sign on a stick, a demonstration
legal.drawing: Protest: a blank picket sign on a stick, a demonstration
legal.why: petition is signatures on paper; a protest is the street. The sign stays blank: no slogan and no political symbol.

legal.name: international-law
legal.meaning: International law: a globe with the balance scale, for treaties, cross-border cases and trade law
legal.drawing: International law: a globe with the balance scale, for treaties, cross-border cases and trade law
legal.why: data-residency is where data is stored; nothing shows law across borders

limpieza.name: broom-sparkle
limpieza.meaning: A broom with sparkles: spotless, deep-cleaned, clean up (also a smart or AI clean-up)
limpieza.drawing: A broom with sparkles: spotless, deep-cleaned, clean up (also a smart or AI clean-up)
limpieza.why: The broom family (check, clock, alert, plus, sync) with the sparkle the set already uses both for clean (hand-sparkles) and for AI (file-sparkle). Lucide's mop-sparkles is the same concept and should map here, not get a second drawing. Limpieza's badges stay at 12 of 87.

limpieza.name: dry-clean
limpieza.meaning: The care label's circle: dry clean, professional cleaning.
limpieza.drawing: The care label's circle: dry clean, professional cleaning.
limpieza.why: garment-bag is the dry-cleaning service. The circle is the fifth care-label family (wash, bleach, dry, iron, professional care) and the only one the set doesn't draw. Its 'do not dry clean' comes from the engine.

logistica.name: doorstep-delivery
logistica.meaning: Left at the door: a closed door with a parcel on the ground in front of it
logistica.drawing: Left at the door: a closed door with a parcel on the ground in front of it
logistica.why: home-delivery (a parcel in a house) is the ship-to-home service; this is the delivery status 'left at the door' with nobody home. Flagged: the judge may count it as the same concept.

logistica.name: parcel-edit
logistica.meaning: Edit shipment: the parcel with the pencil badge, change address or contents
logistica.drawing: Edit shipment: the parcel with the pencil badge, change address or contents

logistica.name: parcel-question
logistica.meaning: Missing package: the parcel with a question badge, 'where is my order'
logistica.drawing: Missing package: the parcel with a question badge, 'where is my order'
logistica.why: parcel-search is tracking a known package; the question badge marks a missing or unidentified one

logistica.name: parcel-minus
logistica.meaning: Remove package: the parcel with a minus badge, take a package out of a shipment or order
logistica.drawing: Remove package: the parcel with a minus badge, take a package out of a shipment or order
logistica.why: parcel-x is a failed delivery; minus is the removal action that pairs with parcel-plus

logistica.name: truck-clock
logistica.meaning: Truck arrival time: the truck with a clock badge, a dock appointment or a vehicle's ETA at a stop
logistica.drawing: Truck arrival time: the truck with a clock badge, a dock appointment or a vehicle's ETA at a stop
logistica.why: delivery-time is a parcel with a clock, the customer's ETA, and calendar-truck is a date. This is the vehicle's time slot. Flagged as near delivery-time.

logistica.name: do-not-stack
logistica.meaning: Do not stack: the ISO 780 handling mark, a box with a crossed-out box on top
logistica.drawing: Do not stack: the ISO 780 handling mark, a box with a crossed-out box on top
logistica.why: the handling marks fragile, this-side-up, keep-dry and keep-from-heat exist; do-not-stack is the missing common one

logistica.name: customs-duty
logistica.meaning: Customs duty: a shipping container with a percent sign, an import tariff
logistica.drawing: Customs duty: a shipping container with a percent sign, an import tariff
logistica.why: clearance is passing customs; the duty is the tax on imports. Named customs-duty because 'tariff' already means price-tag-bolt (energy tariff).

logistica.name: container-snowflake
logistica.meaning: Reefer container: a shipping container with a snowflake
logistica.drawing: Reefer container: a shipping container with a snowflake
logistica.why: the cold-chain family has parcel-snowflake and warehouse-snowflake but no reefer container (truck-refrigerated is the vehicle)

logistica.name: weigh-station
logistica.meaning: Weigh station: a truck in profile on a platform scale (weighbridge)
logistica.drawing: Weigh station: a truck in profile on a platform scale (weighbridge)
logistica.why: weight is a parcel's weight; weighing a loaded truck is a separate step in road freight and yards

logistica.name: shipping-label-x
logistica.meaning: Voided label: the shipping label with an x badge. A purchased label cancelled and refunded before the carrier scans it (the 'void label' action in shipping apps).
logistica.drawing: Voided label: the shipping label with an x badge. A purchased label cancelled and refunded before the carrier scans it (the 'void label' action in shipping apps).
logistica.why: parcel-x is a failed delivery of a parcel already in the carrier's hands. return-label is a prepaid return. Nothing shows a label cancelled before shipping. The shipping-label base has no badges yet.

lugares.name: map-minus
lugares.meaning: A folded map with a minus badge: remove a map or delete an offline map area
lugares.drawing: A folded map with a minus badge: remove a map or delete an offline map area
lugares.why: map-plus adds a map and map-arrow-down downloads one, but nothing removes one. map-pin-minus removes a stop, which is a pin, not a map. The checker's 'contains map-pin-minus' is that other object.

lugares.name: map-pin-heart
lugares.meaning: A map pin with a heart badge: a place the person saved to a favorites list or a wishlist (Saved, Favorites, trip wishlists).
lugares.drawing: A map pin with a heart badge: a place the person saved to a favorites list or a wishlist (Saved, Favorites, trip wishlists).
lugares.why: map-pin-star is a featured or top-rated place that the app recommends. The heart is a place the person saved. Both already sit side by side in bienes-raices as house-star and house-heart.

lugares.name: route-x
lugares.meaning: A route with an x badge: no route found, or a trip or route cancelled.
lugares.drawing: A route with an x badge: no route found, or a trip or route cancelled.
lugares.why: route-alert is an incident on a route that still exists (a closure, traffic). route-x means there is no route. It completes the family's plus, check, alert and clock.

mar.name: sperm-whale
mar.meaning: A sperm whale with its huge box-shaped head and narrow jaw. Used for whales by kind and the deep sea.
mar.drawing: A sperm whale with its huge box-shaped head and narrow jaw. Used for whales by kind and the deep sea.
mar.why: whale is a humpback (keyword). The sperm whale is a kind, told by its square head. names.mjs flags 'contains whale', which is the kind's base.

mar.name: flying-fish
mar.meaning: A flying fish gliding with its wing-like fins spread. Used for the open ocean and tropical seas.
mar.drawing: A flying fish gliding with its wing-like fins spread. Used for the open ocean and tropical seas.
mar.why: Only the spread wing fins tell it apart, and no fish in the set has them. It's a kind of fish, so 'contains fish' is the kind's base.

marketing.name: attribution-linear
marketing.meaning: Linear attribution: the attribution path with every touchpoint the same size, equal credit to each touch
marketing.drawing: Linear attribution: the attribution path with every touchpoint the same size, equal credit to each touch
marketing.why: Only first-touch and last-touch exist. Linear, time-decay and position-based are the other standard models in ad platforms, drawn on the same path with different dot sizes, so the family base holds.

marketing.name: attribution-time-decay
marketing.meaning: Time-decay attribution: the attribution path with touchpoints growing toward the conversion
marketing.drawing: Time-decay attribution: the attribution path with touchpoints growing toward the conversion
marketing.why: last-touch gives all credit to one dot; time-decay spreads it, growing toward the end

marketing.name: attribution-position-based
marketing.meaning: Position-based (U-shaped) attribution: the attribution path with the first and last touchpoints large and the middle ones small
marketing.drawing: Position-based (U-shaped) attribution: the attribution path with the first and last touchpoints large and the middle ones small
marketing.why: first-touch credits one end only; position-based credits both ends

marketing.name: feather-flag
marketing.meaning: Feather flag: the tall curved sail-shaped flag on a pole outside stores, dealerships and events
marketing.drawing: Feather flag: the tall curved sail-shaped flag on a pole outside stores, dealerships and events
marketing.why: pole-banner hangs from a street pole. The feather flag is a separate out-of-home format in the billboard/roll-up/sidewalk-sign set and has nothing to do with edicion's flag (mark).

marketing.name: advertising-column
marketing.meaning: Advertising column: the round street pillar wrapped in posters (Morris column)
marketing.drawing: Advertising column: the round street pillar wrapped in posters (Morris column)
marketing.why: a cylinder covered in posters is its own out-of-home medium, not a board. The 'columns' it contains is the layout icon, another sense of the word.

marketing.name: print-ad
marketing.meaning: Print ad: a newspaper page with one framed ad block
marketing.drawing: Print ad: a newspaper page with one framed ad block
marketing.why: press-clipping is earned coverage cut out of the paper; a print ad is paid space. It completes the ad kinds (search, display, video, interstitial, rewarded) with print.

marketing.name: upsell
marketing.meaning: Upsell: a small box and a larger one with an arrow up between them, offering the bigger plan or product
marketing.drawing: Upsell: a small box and a larger one with an arrow up between them, offering the bigger plan or product
marketing.why: pricing-plans shows the tiers; upsell is the act of moving a customer to a higher one. product-bundle is cross-selling, a different move.

marketing.name: ribbon-cutting
marketing.meaning: Grand opening: scissors cutting a ribbon with a bow, the opening of a store, office or launch event
marketing.drawing: Grand opening: scissors cutting a ribbon with a bow, the opening of a store, office or launch event
marketing.why: bunting and party-popper are celebrations in general; the cut ribbon is specifically an opening, for events marketing and retail

marketing.name: aerial-banner
marketing.meaning: Aerial advertising: a small plane in profile towing a banner
marketing.drawing: Aerial advertising: a small plane in profile towing a banner
marketing.why: mobile-billboard is a truck and airship is the aircraft itself; the plane with a banner is the aerial ad format. The plane stays in profile, per the vehicle rule.

marketing.name: gift-clock
marketing.meaning: Free trial: a gift box with a clock badge, a product or plan given free for a limited time
marketing.drawing: Free trial: a gift box with a clock badge, a product or plan given free for a limited time
marketing.why: bag-clock is a pre-order and sachet is a physical sample; the SaaS free trial has no icon

medio-ambiente.name: bin-textiles
medio-ambiente.meaning: The sorting bin with a shirt on it. Used for textile and clothing recycling, and clothing donation banks.
medio-ambiente.drawing: The sorting bin with a shirt on it. Used for textile and clothing recycling, and clothing donation banks.
medio-ambiente.why: The bin-* family covers paper, plastic, glass, organic, metal, electronics, batteries, and hazardous, but not textiles. shirt-sync means swapping clothes.

medio-ambiente.name: soil-pollution
medio-ambiente.meaning: Layers of soil with a contaminant seeping down. Used for soil pollution and contaminated land.
medio-ambiente.drawing: Layers of soil with a contaminant seeping down. Used for soil pollution and contaminated land.
medio-ambiente.why: toxic-waste is a leaking drum, tagged 'soil contamination'. The pollution family (air-quality, water-pollution, noise-pollution, light-pollution) has no soil, which the scope names. Keep the layers to two so it doesn't read as a diagram.

medio-ambiente.name: water-quality
medio-ambiente.meaning: A droplet with a level meter. Used for the water quality index, and river and drinking-water monitoring.
medio-ambiente.drawing: A droplet with a level meter. Used for the water quality index, and river and drinking-water monitoring.
medio-ambiente.why: water-pollution is the event. This is the monitoring metric, the counterpart of air-quality. ph-strip is a lab test.

medio-ambiente.name: wave-arrow-up
medio-ambiente.meaning: Water waves with an up arrow. Used for a rising water level: a river or reservoir going up, or a flood watch.
medio-ambiente.drawing: Water waves with an up arrow. Used for a rising water level: a river or reservoir going up, or a flood watch.
medio-ambiente.why: Lucide's own note says tide-high is a tide gauge, sea-level-rise is the coast, and flood is the event. The base is lugares's wave, because nucleo's 'waves' is the volume icon.

medio-ambiente.name: wave-arrow-down
medio-ambiente.meaning: Water waves with a down arrow. Used for a falling water level: a reservoir dropping, or drought.
medio-ambiente.drawing: Water waves with a down arrow. Used for a falling water level: a reservoir dropping, or drought.
medio-ambiente.why: It's the falling pair of wave-arrow-up. Same base, same modifier. SF's water.waves.and.arrow.down is the same concept.

medio-ambiente.name: earth-americas
medio-ambiente.meaning: Planet Earth turned to show the Americas. Used for regions and service in the Americas.
medio-ambiente.drawing: Planet Earth turned to show the Americas. Used for regions and service in the Americas.
medio-ambiente.why: earth is a generic globe with two landmasses (the Americas left, Eurasia and Africa upper right). This is the regional view centered on one hemisphere.

medio-ambiente.name: earth-asia
medio-ambiente.meaning: Planet Earth turned to show Asia and Australia. Used for regions and Asia-Pacific.
medio-ambiente.drawing: Planet Earth turned to show Asia and Australia. Used for regions and Asia-Pacific.
medio-ambiente.why: It's the region view SF draws as globe.asia.australia. The generic earth doesn't center Asia.

medio-ambiente.name: earth-south-asia
medio-ambiente.meaning: Planet Earth turned to show India and the Middle East. Used for regions.
medio-ambiente.drawing: Planet Earth turned to show India and the Middle East. Used for regions.
medio-ambiente.why: It's the third regional view SF draws (globe.central.south.asia). Drop it if two regional globes are enough.

medio-ambiente.name: file-leaf
medio-ambiente.meaning: A document with a leaf. Used for going paperless, e-statements, and paper saved.
medio-ambiente.drawing: A document with a leaf. Used for going paperless, e-statements, and paper saved.
medio-ambiente.why: No icon says 'paperless'. It follows the leaf-modifier family (bag-leaf, route-leaf, parcel-leaf, spray-bottle-leaf), and could move to archivos with the file-* family.

medio-ambiente.name: fish-leaf
medio-ambiente.meaning: A fish with a leaf. Used for sustainable seafood and responsibly sourced fish.
medio-ambiente.drawing: A fish with a leaf. Used for sustainable seafood and responsibly sourced fish.
medio-ambiente.why: seal-leaf is the organic label. Sustainable seafood is the eco label menus and stores need, in the same leaf family.

medio-ambiente.name: factory-leaf
medio-ambiente.meaning: A factory with a leaf. Used for green manufacturing and sustainable production.
medio-ambiente.drawing: A factory with a leaf. Used for green manufacturing and sustainable production.
medio-ambiente.why: smokestack-arrow-down means cutting emissions. This is the green-industry label, in the leaf family.

medio-ambiente.name: house-air-quality
medio-ambiente.meaning: A house with two wind lines inside. Used for indoor air quality and ventilation in home air monitors, purifiers, thermostats and HVAC apps.
medio-ambiente.drawing: A house with two wind lines inside. Used for indoor air quality and ventilation in home air monitors, purifiers, thermostats and HVAC apps.
medio-ambiente.why: air-quality is the outdoor index: a gauge with wind, tagged outdoor air and AQI. house-temperature is the indoor temperature. Indoor air quality (CO2, VOC and PM2.5 inside the home) is its own reading in smart-home and air-monitor apps. It reuses the house-temperature base with wind lines in place of the thermometer. The 'contains air-quality' conflict is expected: house is the family base and air quality is the subject, the same pattern as house-temperature. If the judge prefers to keep it next to house-temperature, it also fits electrodomesticos (the smart home).

musica.name: guitar-bass
musica.meaning: An electric bass with its long neck and four tuning pegs; bass lessons, bands.
musica.drawing: An electric bass with its long neck and four tuning pegs; bass lessons, bands.
musica.why: The scope names the bass, and Gota has none. The longer neck and four pegs set it apart. The name puts the family head first, like guitar-electric.

musica.name: sitar
musica.meaning: A sitar with its long neck and round gourd base; Indian classical music.
musica.drawing: A sitar with its long neck and round gourd base; Indian classical music.
musica.why: The long neck and the gourd are unique to it. Gota has no Indian instrument.

musica.name: bagpipes
musica.meaning: Bagpipes: the bag with its drones and chanter; pipe bands, folk music.
musica.drawing: Bagpipes: the bag with its drones and chanter; pipe bands, folk music.
musica.why: The bag with drones over the shoulder is its own instrument, and Gota has nothing like it.

musica.name: guitar-pedal
musica.meaning: A guitar effects pedal: a small box with knobs and a footswitch; effects, pedalboards.
musica.drawing: A guitar effects pedal: a small box with knobs and a footswitch; effects, pedalboards.
musica.why: The amp is a cabinet. The stompbox is the effects unit, part of the scope's production gear.

musica.name: alto-clef
musica.meaning: The alto (C) clef; viola parts, music notation.
musica.drawing: The alto (C) clef; viola parts, music notation.
musica.why: Gota has the treble and bass clefs. The C clef is the third standard clef, and the scope lists clefs.

musica.name: natural-sign
musica.meaning: The natural sign that cancels a sharp or a flat; accidentals, notation.
musica.drawing: The natural sign that cancels a sharp or a flat; accidentals, notation.
musica.why: sharp-sign and flat-sign exist. The natural is the missing third accidental.

musica.name: concert-stage
musica.meaning: An outdoor concert stage with its roof truss and speaker stacks; concerts, festivals.
musica.drawing: An outdoor concert stage with its roof truss and speaker stacks; concerts, festivals.
musica.why: theater is the curtained indoor stage (tagged 'stage'). The scope lists concerts and stages, and a truss with speakers is the concert one.

musica.name: playlist-minus
musica.meaning: A playlist with a minus; remove a song from a playlist.
musica.drawing: A playlist with a minus; remove a song from a playlist.
musica.why: playlist-plus, playlist-check and playlist-arrow-down exist. Removing is a real action, as with cart-minus and mail-minus.

musica.name: playlist-lock
musica.meaning: A playlist with a lock badge: a private playlist that only you can see (Spotify's and YouTube Music's 'make private').
musica.drawing: A playlist with a lock badge: a private playlist that only you can see (Spotify's and YouTube Music's 'make private').
musica.why: The playlist badges are add, added, download, and minus (approved). Music apps show the private/public state on the playlist itself, and image-lock (private photo) and journal-lock already set the pattern. eye-lock is a generic private view, not a playlist. Música's badges go from 9 to 10 of about 101.

nautica.name: hovercraft
nautica.meaning: A hovercraft in profile on its skirt with a rear fan: hovercraft crossings
nautica.drawing: A hovercraft in profile on its skirt with a rear fan: hovercraft crossings
nautica.why: The set has no air-cushion craft. The skirt and the rear fan are what show it.

nautica.name: paddle-steamer
nautica.meaning: A river steamboat with a paddle wheel and funnels: river cruises and heritage boats
nautica.drawing: A river steamboat with a paddle wheel and funnels: river cruises and heritage boats
nautica.why: ferry and cruise-ship are modern hulls. The paddle wheel is what shows a river steamer.

nautica.name: inflatable-boat
nautica.meaning: An inflatable boat (RIB) with its tubes and an outboard: dinghies, tenders, and boat tours
